'''Techno-Syndicalism''' is a source-listed branch of [[Syndicalism]].

The current source list gives only the name and parent ideology. It does not identify a founder, state, party, workplace movement, or relationship to Veszpremi [[Orderism]].

== Canon Limits ==

Do not treat Techno-Syndicalism as a Veszpremi, Vorkutan, or Zhensanovian ideology until a stronger source connects it to those states or movements.
